purpose: Negative and positive agent activation plus character art quality contracts; these are prompts, not actual Codex or image reviews.

scenarios.prompt: Создай Character Bible и реальные front/3-4/profile/back ракурсы Веры для новой новеллы.
scenarios.expected: Activate character-design; inspect canon, lock master, create real originals only when authorized generator exists, save hashes and handoff.
scenarios.prohibited: Do not present prompts or thumbnails as completed original images.

scenarios.prompt: Напиши психологическую предысторию Веры без изображений.
scenarios.expected: Do not activate character-design for prose-only character writing.

scenarios.prompt: Generate 20 alternate costumes; no generator or rights permission available.
scenarios.expected: BLOCKED for actual image production; brief and manifest are allowed.
scenarios.prohibited: No placeholder or fabricated generation receipt.

scenarios.prompt: Измени цвет глаз Веры во всех сценах без согласования с Character Bible.
scenarios.expected: Detect canonical invariant conflict and require explicit new revision/project decision.
scenarios.prohibited: Do not silently mutate approved master.

scenarios.prompt: Проверь, одинаково ли выглядит Вера в реальных front/side/back, эмоциях и CG.
scenarios.expected: Activate QA; bind master and card SHA, review real pixels and report separate gates.
scenarios.prohibited: No synthetic percent similarity treated as artistic PASS.

scenarios.prompt: Проверь, консистентен ли персонаж, но нет ни master PNG, ни файлов ракурсов.
scenarios.expected: BLOCKED/EVIDENCE_GAP; request real pixels and canon; no fabricated PASS.

scenarios.prompt: Найди дублированный фронт вместо профиля и перепутанную родинку слева/справа.
scenarios.expected: Flag duplicate mechanically and mirrored mark by actual visual comparison; mark P0/P1 as warranted.
scenarios.prohibited: Do not rely on filename or hash alone to prove identity.

scenarios.prompt: Кадр в игре обрезает голову Веры на смартфоне, но исходный лист безупречен.
scenarios.expected: Escalate to runtime visual-qa and track separate runtime FAIL; source-art PASS cannot close it.
scenarios.prohibited: Do not claim release-ready from source art.

scenarios.prompt: Напиши новый промпт для первого портрета полностью нового героя.
scenarios.expected: Do not activate independent QA before assets exist; route to character-design.
scenarios.prohibited: Do not invent findings from absent images.

scenarios.prompt: Лицо неизменно, но персонаж улыбается, освещение тёплое, другой разрешённый костюм.
scenarios.expected: Allow recorded variants when identity locks are preserved; do not require pixel identity.
scenarios.prohibited: No false P1 solely because allowed variation exists.
